risks.title: Volatile Market
risks.summary: Market conditions can affect the volume and size of transactions, potentially reducing the company's revenues. Factors such as access to credit markets, high interest rates, inflation, and economic uncertainty directly impact M&A and financial restructuring advisory activities
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to market fluctuations, which can impact its revenue and earnings. Economic and market conditions may reduce the volume and size of advisory transactions (Item 1A Risk Factors)

risks.title: Increased Competition
risks.summary: Heightened competition may reduce the company's market share and impact its financial results in M&A, restructuring, and valuation advisory services
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly specialized and competitive independent investment banking environment

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.summary: Credit risks may reduce the company's revenues and impact its financial results, particularly in financial restructuring services
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to client commitments and market conditions

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: Regulatory changes may affect the company's financial results, particularly in compliance, data protection, and international trade policies
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict financial services industry regulations

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.summary: Geopolitical events, military conflicts, international trade policies, and global trade disruptions may reduce the company's revenues and impact its financial results
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to geopolitical risks, including military conflicts in Eastern Europe and the Middle East that affect transactions and market conditions (Item 1A Risk Factors)

risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.summary: Cyberattacks and malicious campaigns may reduce the company's revenues, damage its reputation, and impact its financial results
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to cybersecurity risks as a financial services provider handling sensitive information

risks.title: International Dependence
risks.summary: International operations across 35 global offices may be affected by geopolitical events, currency fluctuations, trade policies, and local regulations
risks.score_rationale: The company relies significantly on international operations, generating 28.7% of its revenues from non-U.S. activities ($687M out of $2.39B)
